name: Apple___Apple_scab
description: Apple scab is a common agricultural disease affecting Apple plants, causing significant yield losses if left unmanaged.
symptoms: Visual symptoms include irregular spotting, discoloration, or structural damage on the leaves and sometimes fruit of the Apple.

treatments.method: Apply appropriate broad-spectrum fungicide or bactericide approved for Apple.
treatments.application_frequency: Every 7-14 days as per label instructions.
treatments.safety_precautions: Wear PPE. Observe harvest intervals.

treatments.method: Apply neem oil, copper fungicides, or biological control agents.
treatments.application_frequency: Weekly during early disease onset.
treatments.safety_precautions: Apply during early morning or late evening to prevent leaf burn.

preventions.measure: Ensure proper spacing for air circulation and practice crop rotation.
